mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_config (name, base_url, api_key, model, temperature, enabled) VALUES (#{name}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{model}, #{temperature}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_model_config SET name = #{name}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, api_key = #{apiKey}, model = #{model}, temperature = #{temperature}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_model_config SET enabled = TRUE, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
